I told Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on **25 November**.

- **Where it comes from:** Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 Oct. Marcus is in that channel, so he can see the source himself. Nothing posted there since changes it.
- **What I checked:** I only read #north-team. None of the shared files he can open cover the Brackenwater renewal, so the date rests on Ilse's post alone.
- **Sharing:** A renewal date counts as an account detail, not a money figure, so it was fine to share with Marcus and the North team.
